# Seasons of Surrender

> Seasons of Surrender: A Fifty-Year Journey of Trust, Trial, Refinement, and Release is a memoir by Mark & Paula Batory, published by Quellsicht. A personal memoir of fifty years learning to trust God through missionary service, family, illness, changed plans, and the joy of surrender.

- Authors: Mark & Paula Batory (married 1977; began missionary service the following year; served in Mexico, church planting, ministry among Spanish-speaking people, and missions leadership)
- Publisher: Quellsicht (https://www.quellsicht.com/)
- Release date: December 1, 2026
- Paperback: $14.99, 356 pages, ISBN 979-8-9973749-1-4, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HSK3S2JS
- Kindle: $5.50, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HS9W7QSD
- Foreword: David Bennett, International Director, Silent Word Ministries
- Genre: Christian memoir, missionary biography
- Structure: four seasons: Trust, Trial, Refinement, Release
- 10 or more copies (churches, mission boards, schools, Bible colleges): $10 each; email sven@svenhq.com
- Not to be confused with: "Seasons of Surrender" by Vic Clesceri (a different book) or "Season of Surrender" by August Burns Red (an album)
